Datara Studiothe interface server is not answering

What this means

This window is the desktop shell. The editor, the file tree and the compiler are served by a separate Datara process on loopback, and that process is not responding. The shell keeps trying to start it.

checking ...

If it stays like this

Run the server by hand, in the studio directory, and read what it prints:

cd "…"
forgen run src/main.dtr

The usual causes, in order:

- forgen is not on PATH, so the shell could not start it.
- Another instance already holds every port it tried.
- ui/studio.html is missing. Build it with node scripts/build-ui.mjs.

This page reloads into the editor by itself as soon as a server answers, so it is safe to leave open while you fix the cause.
